name: threadify-workflows
description: Public-safe, open-source workflow manifests and agent adapters for Threadify MCP.

scripts.bundle:build: node scripts/build-qbr-bundle.mjs && node scripts/build-creator-bundles.mjs && node scripts/build-advanced-bundles.mjs
scripts.bundle:check: node scripts/build-qbr-bundle.mjs --check && node scripts/build-creator-bundles.mjs --check && node scripts/build-advanced-bundles.mjs --check
scripts.test:creator: node --test validation/creator-tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:installer && npm run test:creator && npm run test:offer-builder
